note: Industry radar data layer. Facts policy applies here too: every item links to a source; nothing is invented. items[] = dated news events; milestones[] = the curated industry timeline (high GEO value, feed-agnostic). The fetch-news pipeline (scripts/fetch-news.mjs) merges automated items in and preserves pinned/manual entries.

items.title: CoreWeave delivers NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 performance at production scale, starting with Cognition
items.note: Rubin racks move from launch to revenue workloads ~9 months after CES — the liquid-only generation is live. CoreWeave had done the industry-first bring-up/validation in June 2026.

items.title: Supermicro begins shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks
items.note: 72 Rubin GPUs + 36 Vera CPUs per rack; up to 6,000 racks/month at full production; 16-rack design = 1,152 GPUs / 331 TB HBM4. First volume deliveries of the 100%-liquid, 45 °C warm-water generation.

items.title: Singapore publishes SS 726:2026 — first national standard for liquid cooling in tropical climates
items.source: Singapore Standards / this site's standards tracker
items.note: Covers direct-to-chip in tropical data centers; excludes standalone edge cabinets — scope matters when vendors claim compliance.

items.title: AMD launches Instinct MI400 series and the Helios rack-scale platform (Advancing AI 2026)
items.note: MI455X-powered Helios racks entered full production with first shipments late Q3 2026 — liquid cooling is now the default interface across both accelerator ecosystems, not just NVIDIA's.

items.title: NVIDIA: Vera Rubin ramps into full production for agentic AI factories
items.note: The ramp between CES launch (Jan) and first rack shipments (Sept) — the supply chain's dress rehearsal for 2.3 kW-class GPUs.

items.title: NVIDIA launches the Rubin platform at CES 2026 — in full production on day one
items.note: 2.3 kW-class GPUs (Max-P), 180-220 kW racks, 45 °C warm-water cooling, 100% liquid coverage with zero fans — the first AI platform generation with no air-cooled SKU at all.

items.title: 3M completes its exit from PFAS manufacturing, ending fluorinated coolant production
items.note: Announced Dec 2022, completed end-2025. Single-fluid-class dependence is now a procurement risk — PG25 water-glycol is the default survivor.

items.title: OCP ORv3 blind-mate liquid cooling manifold spec reaches Rev 1.0
items.note: Servers that mate on insertion, interoperable across vendors — the lock-in defense checklist item in our RFQ tool.

items.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 mainstreams 120 kW liquid-cooled racks
items.note: Announced at GTC 2024: rack-scale liquid cooling left the exotic category. The power cliff behind this guide's existence.

items.title: 3M announces exit from all PFAS manufacturing by end of 2025
items.note: The announcement that redirected immersion-cooling fluid roadmaps for the entire industry.

items.title: STULZ × CoolIT ship the first turnkey liquid-cooled micro data center
items.source: STULZ product page (verified in our comparison data)
items.note: Still the only full predecessor in the 20-50 kW turnkey cabinet space — see the gap statement in our cabinet comparison.
